welcomeDesc: KnowledgeMap is an AI-powered knowledge management app with knowledge graphs, spaced repetition learning, and smart task scheduling.
welcomeFeature1: Knowledge Graph — Visualize and organize knowledge
welcomeFeature2: AI Assistant — Intelligent generation and Q&A
supabaseDesc: KnowledgeMap uses Supabase as the backend database service. You need to register a free Supabase account to store your data.
supabaseFree: Supabase offers a free tier that's sufficient for personal use.
supabaseOwnData: Your data is stored in your own Supabase project, fully under your control.
projectStep2: Click "New Project" to create a new project
projectStep3: Enter project name and database password (save it securely)
projectStep4: Select the region closest to you
projectStep5: Wait for the project to be created (about 1-2 minutes)
credentialsDesc: In the Supabase Dashboard, go to Settings → API to find the following information.
credentialsDbUrlDesc: In the Supabase Dashboard, go to Settings → Database → Connection string to find the database connection string.
statusEmpty: Database is empty. Table structure needs to be initialized.
statusPartial: Database is partially initialized. Migrations need to be completed.
statusNeedsUpgrade: Database needs upgrade. New migrations are pending.
aiOptional: Configure at least one AI service to enable AI features. You can skip this and configure later in Settings.
completeDesc: You have completed all necessary configuration and can start using KnowledgeMap.
